Boolean AddLink ( String  selection,
String  link,
Boolean  autoLink 
)

Adds a link on one or more actors. (If several actors have the same name each one will be linked.)

Parameters:
selectionas Selection, specifies the actors. For example:

By name: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
</CLitSelection>

By ID: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#
</CLitSelection>
linkas String, specifies the link (for example: file://C:\Documents and Settings\User\Desktop\File.pdf).
autoLinkas Boolean, specifies whether to open the associated application to display the link (True) or not (False).
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure

Boolean AddMetaPropertyDefinition ( String  name,
CrMetaPropertyType  metaType,
String  metaLabel,
Long  stateFlags,
CrMetaPropertyUnit  unit,
Boolean  bounded,
Single  minValue,
Single  maxValue 
)

Adds a meta-property definition to the active document.

Parameters:
nameas String, specifies the meta-property name.
metaTypeas CrMetaPropertyType enum, specifies the meta-property data type:

  • crMptBoolean (0)
  • crMptInteger (1)
  • crMptFloating (2)
  • crMptString (3)
  • crMptDate (4)
  • crMptColor (5)
metaLabelas String, specifies the text displayed in the Properties pane.
stateFlagsas Long (CrMetaPropertyAttribute bit mask), specifies meta-property attributes:

  • crMpaAnimable (2)
  • crMpaMergeable (4)
  • crMpaVisible (8)
unitas CrMetaPropertyUnit enum, specifies the meta-property units:

  • crMpuNone (0)
  • crMpuAcceleration (1)
  • crMpuAngle (2)
  • crMpuArea (3)
  • crMpuLength (4)
  • crMpuSpeed (5)
  • crMpuTime (6)
  • crMpuVolume (7)
boundedas Boolean, specifies if there are minimum and maximum values (True) or not (False). Applicable to Integer and Floating types only.
minValueas Single, specifies the minimum value. Not applicable if not bounded.
maxValueas Single, specifies the maximum value. Not applicable if not bounded.
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure
See also:
AddMetaProperties()

String AddSignature ( String  LogoPath,
String  UsageAgreement,
CrDisplaySignatureMode  eSignatureDisplayMode 
)

Adds a signature to a Composer file, if the signature does not already exist in the file.

Parameters:
LogoPathas String, specifies the image file to use for the logo
UsageAgreementas String, specifies the text, typically a usage agreement
eSignatureDisplayModeas CrDisplaySignatureMode, specifies the signature dispaly mode

  • crAskForAgreement: The recipient must click I agree to accept or I disagree to decline the agreement. If declined, Composer Player does not load the file
  • crShowOnly: The recipient must click OK to dismiss the signature page upon opening the file in Composer Player
  • crNoDisplay: Composer Player does not display the signature page
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure

Boolean CreateCallout ( String  selection,
CrCalloutGenMode  eGenMode,
CrCalloutGenAttach  eGenAttach 
)

Creates a callout for the selection made by the user.

Parameters:
selectionas String, specifies the actors on which callouts need to be created. By name: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
</CLitSelection>

By ID: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#
</CLitSelection>
eGenModeas CrCalloutGenMode, specifies the Generation Mode for callout creation:

  • crCalloutGenModeEachInstance: creates one callout per instance.
  • crCalloutGenModeEachBomIDSingle: creates one callout per BOM ID. Only one callout is created, even if several actors have the same BOM ID.
  • crCalloutGenModeEachBomIDMulti: creates one multi-callout per BOM ID.
eGenAttachas CrCalloutGenMode, specifies the Attach mode for callout creation:

  • crCalloutGenAttachCenterBoundingBox: callouts are created at the center of the actor's bounding box.
  • crCalloutGenAttachNearestToCenter: callouts are created as close as possible to the center.
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure

String GetAllActorsOnFilter ( String  propertySet,
Boolean  matchValue 
)

Returns actors matching the specified PropertySet or filter expression. Note: Use GetOnFilter() to include assemblies.

Parameters:
propertySetas String, specifies the PropertySet or filter expression (as found in .smgFilterSet filter profiles) or the complete path pointing to the .smgFilterSet file.

PropertySet Example: 

<CLitPropertySet>
  <Actor.Alpha Value="255"/>
  <Actor.Color R="255" G="0" B="0"/>
</CLitPropertySet>


Filter Expression Example: 

<CLitOperatorSet>
  <Filter.Mode Value="0"/>
  <Operator Type="StringMatch">
    <Actor.Name Value="^prod[0-9]*"/>
  </Operator>
  <Operator Type="EnumEqual">
    <Meta.ProductType Value="15"/>
  </Operator>
</CLitOperatorSet>

This example returns all actors whose name starts with "prod0" through "prod9" and whose Meta.ProductType meta-property is 15.

Note:

  • <Filter.Mode> is required when multiple operator expressions are specified. "0" indicates intersection mode (all the expressions must match), and "1" indicates union mode (any one expression must match).
  • For <Operator Type>, specify a data-type and operator combination. See the following table. Green check marks indicate valid combinations. For example, specify "BoolEqual", "ColorDiff", or "LinkExist".

Tip: To simplify the specification of filter expressions, create filter profiles from the Composer Filters workshop and then copy the content of the resulting .smgFilterSet files.

matchValueas Boolean, specifies whether to return actors for which properties are defined (False) or for which properties are equal to the specified property set (True).

Note: When propertySet specifies a filter profile string, matchValue is ignored (always True).
Returns:
Selection of actors matching the specified PropertySet or filter expression
See also:
GetAllActors()
GetAllActorsByType()

String GetChildren ( String  selection,
Long  mask 
)

Returns all actors that are children of a specified Selection.

Parameters:
selectionas Selection, specifies the parent. For example:

By name: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
</CLitSelection>

By ID: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#
</CLitSelection>
maskas Long (CrObjectType bit mask), specifies what object types in the Selection for which to return children:

  • crObjAssys (1): Assemblies
  • crObjCADViews (2): CAD Views
  • crObjCADCaptures (4): CAD Captures
  • crObjAllChildren (7): crObjAssys + crObjCADViews + crObjCADCaptures

Example: To get the children of assemblies and CAD views: mask = crObjAssys + crObjCADViews

Returns:
Selection containing the children
See also:
GetChildrenView();

String GetOnFilter ( String  propertySet,
Boolean  matchValue 
)

Returns actors and assemblies matching the specified PropertySet or filter expression. Note: Use GetAllActorsOnFilter() to exclude assemblies.

Parameters:
propertySetas String, specifies the PropertySet or filter expression (as found in .smgFilterSet filter profiles) or the complete path pointing to the .smgFilterSet file.

PropertySet Example: 

<CLitPropertySet>
  <Actor.Alpha Value="255"/>
  <Actor.Color R="255" G="0" B="0"/>
</CLitPropertySet>


Filter Expression Example: 

<CLitOperatorSet>
  <Filter.Mode Value="0"/>
  <Operator Type="StringMatch">
    <Actor.Name Value="^prod[0-9]*"/>
  </Operator>
  <Operator Type="EnumEqual">
    <Meta.ProductType Value="15"/>
  </Operator>
</CLitOperatorSet>

This example returns all actors whose name starts with "prod0" through "prod9" and whose Meta.ProductType meta-property is 15.

Note:

  • <Filter.Mode> is required when multiple operator expressions are specified. "0" indicates intersection mode (all the expressions must match), and "1" indicates union mode (any one expression must match).
  • For <Operator Type>, specify a data-type and operator combination. See the following table. Green check marks indicate valid combinations. For example, specify "BoolEqual", "ColorDiff", or "LinkExist".

Tip: To simplify the specification of filter expressions, create filter profiles from the Composer Filters workshop and then copy the content of the resulting .smgFilterSet files.

matchValueas Boolean, specifies whether to return actors for which properties are defined (False) or for which properties are equal to the specified property set (True).

Note: When propertySet specifies a filter profile string, matchValue is ignored (always True).
Returns:
Selection of actors and assemblies matching the specified PropertySet or filter expression
See also:
GetAllActorsOnFilter()
Long GetOptionsPro (  )

Returns the Right Manager rights granted in the Composer file.

Returns:
CrFileRights enum bit-mask value containing the Right Manager options activated in the Composer file.

  • crFlrCuttingPlanes (2)
  • crFlrSave (4)
  • <unused> (8)
  • crFlrAdvancedActiveX (16)
  • crFlrTrees (32)
  • crFlrSimulation (64)
  • crFlrLoadingOnDemand (128)
  • crFlrBOMs (256)
  • <unused> (512)
  • crFlrFreezePublication (1024)
  • crFlrForbidDeleteParts (2048)
  • crFlrForbidDeleteActors (16384)

<CLitPropertySet>
<Navigator.Camera.Fov Value="0,6955351"/>
<Navigator.Camera.Height Value="269,6339"/>
<Navigator.Camera.Location>
<Frame>
<Origin X="458,7102" Y="176,8242" Z="7,390127"/>
<VX X="0,1878734" Y="1,747836E-02" Z="-0,9820377"/>
<VY X="-0,226504" Y="0,9736631" Z="-2,600312E-02"/>
</Frame>
<Pivot>
<Origin X="-1,559513" Y="67,34763" Z="-82,61243"/>
<VX X="0,1878734" Y="1,747836E-02" Z="-0,9820377"/>

8cb9b30b4874ac23#

  • crAtvGhost (3): Ghost

None
